doc.brief: An interface that is used to implement shortcut scopes.
doc.md:
An interface that is used to implement shortcut scopes.

This is important for [`Native`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Native) widgets that have their
own surface, since the event controllers that are used to implement
managed and global scopes are limited to the same native.

Examples for widgets implementing `GtkShortcutManager` are
[`Window`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Window) and [`Popover`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Popover).

Every widget that implements `GtkShortcutManager` will be used as a
`GTK_SHORTCUT_SCOPE_MANAGED`.
